title: The Invisible Structure of Time: Hidden Dimensions as Reality Support
content: The Theory of the Invisible Structure of Time and the Hidden Dimensions (TEITDO) proposes that observable spacetime is supported by invisible, internally folded dimensions organized as a coherent vector mesh. Based on the postulate ω⋅ε−=−1, which defines the equilibrium between angular frequency and vectorial resistance, the model describes a dimensional infrastructure capable of stabilizing the universe without dark matter or dark energy. 2D, 3D, and 4D simulations demonstrate how these folded layers generate stable galactic rotation curves and harmonicall regulated tension fields. Analogies with corrugated paper, pomegranate, cubes, and mesh structures enhance conceptual clarity. TEITDO also connects with other original theories by the author—Octagonal Mesh, Infinite Vectors, Emergent Dimensional Mirroring, and the Fractal Structure of the Pomegranate—forming a unified ontological system. This work offers a mathematically consistent and physically grounded alternative cosmological framework.
